purpose: Original Bangkok-inspired game storefront textures; fictional businesses, not surveyed shop locations.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production game texture, one orthographic Bangkok ground-floor shophouse facade. Primary request: a modest Thai massage shop on a Sukhumvit side street: faded muted plum signboard with the exact simple words THAI MASSAGE in cream, aluminum sliding glass doors, sheer beige curtains pulled partway aside, two empty burgundy reclining foot massage chairs visible through the glass, a small bamboo blind, scuffed cream columns, a small brass door bell. Warm practical interior lighting. Composition: the entire image is ONE rectangular shop front, 4 meters wide and 3.6 meters tall, straight-on orthographic view exactly perpendicular to the facade. No perspective convergence. Left and right edges end at the side pillars; top edge ends at the top of the sign; bottom ends at the door threshold. No sidewalk or street outside, no sky, no second floor, no adjacent shops, no margins or surrounding background. Photographic believable Bangkok materials and wear, diffuse overcast daylight outside with soft neutral illumination and no cast sun shadows. Fine authentic surface details at game-ready resolution. No watermark, no people, no animals, no vehicles, no perspective foreground props. Entire rectangular image filled edge to edge with the facade texture. The sign should be clean and legible. Make a high-quality nearly square texture image.
